decision: The current protocol has no eligible efficacy result. Gate 2 is a receipt-bound synthetic engineering failure, all gate receipts authorize nothing, local ground-truth provenance is not established, and the result/evaluator path is not integrated. The authoritative tracker understates the Gate-2 FAIL as BLOCKED/not run; therefore experiment integrity fails until records are reconciled and any future route is explicitly revised.

A_ground_truth_provenance.summary: The config hashes agree with the historical train/validation provenance reports, but both local source files are absent and Gate 0 records no typed adapter, feature/vault split, eligibility manifest, or isolation receipt. No current local GT provenance chain exists for evaluation.

B_score_normalization.summary: The isolated count scorer performs person-within-video normalized absolute error followed by an unweighted video mean, uses continuous unclipped predictions, applies half-even rounding only to AvgOBO, performs the frozen paired nine-component bootstrap, and reports Period AP on [0,100]. In-memory fixtures reproduced the declared values. These metrics were not used on experiment data.

C_result_file_and_number_existence.summary: The Gate-2 numbers and pack hashes exist and independently reproduce, and the Gate-3 CPU receipt reproduces. No narrative/result-claim file, prediction result, or eligible efficacy score exists. The tracker fails to record the extant Gate-2 FAIL.

D_dead_code_and_metric_invocation.summary: No static import or literal reference to pams.warp_phase.evaluator exists outside evaluator.py under src/pams or scripts/experiments. The CLI exposes gates and a blocked training preflight, not evaluation. Gate 1 itself records the evaluator witness schema as missing.

E_actual_scope_vs_language.summary: The scientific claim files correctly say prospective, partial-cache, GT-bbox-assisted, supplied-track, and zero results, but current-status documents are stale: Gate 2 is shown as BLOCKED/not run although its receipt is FAIL. The proposal also describes unit fixtures inside the 1,000 pack while the implementation uses a separate unit pack.

F_evaluation_classification.summary: The only quantitative failure is synthetic selector-gate evidence, not model efficacy or real-data evaluation. It is nevertheless a frozen K5-style protocol failure and prevents phase-mass or performance claims. Gate-1 pack checks and Gate-3 CPU checks are engineering evidence only.

findings.title: The authoritative status records suppress an extant Gate-2 FAIL

evidence.detail: status=FAIL; all five fixture threshold checks are false; authorizes is empty
computed fixture checks are copied into the receipt
any violated fixture threshold sets terminal_failure=True
terminal failure is serialized as status FAIL
G2-SELECTOR-CPU is still recorded as BLOCKED
Gate 2 is still presented as a future launch
the pipeline says Gates 0-2 have not run

findings.consequence: A positive selector, phase-mass, training, efficacy, or novelty claim is forbidden. The Gate-2 failure may not be relabeled as pending or merely blocked.

findings.title: Ground-truth provenance and physical label isolation are not locally established

evidence.detail: the declared train/val source paths and hashes are proposal inputs
the source pickle co-locates inputs and privileged targets and requires a physical split
both sources fail with FileNotFoundError; adapter, pack/vault audit, component manifest, and import-isolation receipt are absent
Gate 0 always appends the missing adapter/vault/manifest/isolation blockers

findings.consequence: No learner or evaluator may consume the label-mixed pickles, and no real-data result can be accepted.

findings.title: The result-producing evaluator path is uninvoked and incomplete

evidence.detail: the count scorer exists only as an isolated function
the supplied-track Period AP adapter exists only as an isolated function
the only post-gate command is a training interface documented as blocked
complete_numerical_witness_set is false and evaluator witness schema is missing
prediction_schema and tiny_gpu_jobs are false

findings.consequence: No experimental AvgMAE, AvgOBO, Period AP, bootstrap endpoint, harmonic gate, or K4 result exists. In-memory audit smoke values are not experiment results.

findings.title: Earlier fixture adjudications do not bind the current gate implementation

evidence.detail: the audit binds gates.py at 52d573a0...
the repair calls 52d573a0... the current gates hash
the later unit receipt binds the actual current gates hash 3a91e776...

findings.consequence: The canonical synthetic pack remains byte-bound, but the earlier repair adjudication cannot serve as current gate-code review evidence.

findings.title: Non-finite harmonic classification disagrees with the period addendum

evidence.detail: nonfinite_class is specified as off-grid
non-finite selector periods raise EvaluationError
non-finite evaluator periods raise EvaluationError

findings.consequence: The evaluator contract must choose global failure or off-grid classification before it can be frozen; no result is currently affected because the evaluator is uninvoked.
